title: Econometrics
text:
Preface
These notes are based on my lectures on introductory econometrics at Pompeu Fabra University during the 2023–24 and 2024–25 academic years, for which we used Introduction to Econometrics by Stock and Watson as the reference book.

title: 1  Introduction
text:
1.1 Introduction
This is a book created from markdown and executable code.
See Knuth (1984) for additional discussion of literate programming.
